meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扩展 NanoClaw,接入新渠道、调整触发与路由。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想按需扩展 NanoClaw 的功能和连接。
copy.tagline_en: Extend NanoClaw with new channels, triggers, and integrations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to customize NanoClaw's behavior and add new capabilities.

howto.what: 装上后,当你想给 NanoClaw 加能力或改行为时,它会先问几个问题弄清需求,再在对应位置改配置——加渠道、加 MCP 集成、改触发规则或助手人设等,最后告诉你怎么验证。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 添加新渠道、接入集成、修改触发规则或路由等定制时触发。

say.text: 帮我加一个 Telegram 渠道,接到现有的 agent group 上
say.note: 先装适配器,再创建 messaging group 并接线

say.text: 把 Gmail 接成 MCP 工具,只给这个 agent group 用
改一下这个 agent group 的人设和回复风格

howto.what_en: After install, when you want to add capabilities or change NanoClaw behavior, it asks clarifying questions, then edits the right config — channels, integrations, triggers, persona — and tells you how to verify.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a new channel, add an integration, change triggers or routing, or otherwise customize NanoClaw.

say_en.text: Add a Telegram channel and wire it to my existing agent group
say_en.note: Installs adapter, then creates messaging group and wiring

say_en.text: Hook up Gmail as an MCP tool for this agent group only
say_en.note: Runs /add-gmail-tool and routes credentials via OneCLI

say_en.text: Change this agent group's persona and reply style
